name: Clock probe: a 180 s spell cooldown counts down by the game time of a 60 s wait
contract: Icy Veins 12472 in the installed Spell.dbc is instant with RecoveryTime 180000 ms, Category 0 and
StartRecoveryCategory 0, so one cast starts a single 180 s player cooldown and no global cooldown. No script or
SQL row changes it. Player::_AddSpellCooldown stores the end in game milliseconds and GetSpellCooldownDelay
subtracts getMSTime(), so the reading falls by exactly the game time that passes. The Icy Veins aura shows that
the cast was accepted before any reading. Three step ticks after the cast it reads 179000..180000. After a
60000 ms wait it has fallen by 60000 ms plus the few step ticks around the wait (at most 500 ms, robust to a
25 ms world step), leaving 119000..120000. A cooldown clock that ignores fast-forwarded game time stays near
180000; one that runs ahead of it falls by more than 60.5 s.
